headline: Durk NOT FREE: Feds Demand 2nd Murder Trial in 20 Days, Judge Orders Custody
body: Trap Lore Ross reports on Instagram that Lil Durk is not free following a federal court order. The post states feds want a second murder trial within 20 days, with Durk remaining in custody. The post has garnered 16K likes and 2,398 comments as of September 11, 2026.

caption:
